thread:
anya: quick sync — my console PR depends on API cutting a new minor tag (v2.3.0). blocked on SDK consumers and helm chart updates. can we coordinate merge order and avoid deploy freeze window?

devon: noted. tests flaked yesterday, rerunning now. if green I can cut the tag today. ETA ~2h. @mike can you hold SDK merge until tag exists?

mike: yep will hold. ping me when the tag is pushed and I'll open the SDK bump PR. :+1:

jess: FYI helm chart needs the console image tag bump after console build. I'll prepare the chart PR but won't merge until runtime image is published. also let's not merge during 16:00-17:00 UTC deploy freeze.

ci-bot: api/unit-tests — rerun queued (job #789) — now running

devon: tests passed. cutting tag now.

devon: pushed tag v2.3.0 -> https://github.com/redwood/api/releases/tag/v2.3.0

mike: started SDK PR to bump dependency to v2.3.0 (github.com/redwood/sdk#210). requesting review from @anya.

anya: ack. I'll review SDK change in ~30m.

jess: chart PR is staged: refs/helm/console-chart#55. holding merge until console image and console PR land.

mike: SDK PR looks good to me, added an approval. @devon can you cut a canary build for console so QA can smoke test? example steps:
```
make canary-image TAG=console-v2.3.0-canary
kubectl set image deployment/console console=registry.redwood/console:console-v2.3.0-canary -n canary\```

devon: canary build kicked off, pushing image to staging registry.

ops-bot: Canaries deployed to namespace canary at 2024-05-14T16:20:00Z

anya: QA did a quick pass on canary, nothing blocking. I'll merge console PR in ~15m, then we can merge helm and SDK in sequence. will post when merged. :rocket:

anya: console PR merged (sha abc123). starting rollout.

jess: helm chart merged and image bumped to console-v2.3.0. rollout scheduled for 17:00 UTC small window.

mike: SDK released v0.9.1 with API v2.3.0 deps. :tada:

anya: thanks all — this unblocks the feature work and downstream consumers. closing the loop.
